The mission of the Department of Justice is to uphold the rule of law, to keep our country safe, and to protect civil rights.
*   Independence and Impartiality.
We work each day to earn the public’s trust by following the facts and the law wherever they may lead, without prejudice or improper influence.
*   Honesty and Integrity.
Our employees adhere to the highest standards of ethical behavior, mindful that, as public servants, we must work to earn the trust of, and inspire confidence in, the public we serve.
*   Respect.
Our employees value differences in people and in ideas and treat everyone with fairness, dignity, and compassion.
*   Excellence.
We work every day to provide the highest levels of service to the American people and to be a responsible steward of the taxpayers’ dollars.
The Department of Justice consists of multiple components and agencies dedicated to upholding our mission.
